Preventing Plumbing Emergencies

Stay ahead of plumbing issues with these simple tips from Carolina Heating Service:

  • Schedule Regular Maintenance: Keep your system in peak condition with yearly inspections.
  • Avoid Drain Blockages: Be mindful of what you put down your drains.
  • Fix Leaks Early: Address small leaks before they become major problems.
  • Protect Pipes: Insulate pipes in winter to prevent freezing and bursting.
  • Be Proactive: Don’t ignore warning signs like slow drains or unusual water pressure.
